description: This file defines the Proxy class providing static methods to create combined handler functions for synchronous and streaming HTTP requests within the GuzzleHttp library.

classes.name: Proxy
classes.description: Provides static methods to create proxy handlers that route requests either synchronously or streaming.

methods.name: wrapSync
methods.description: Creates a combined handler that routes requests to either a default or a synchronous handler based on the 'synchronous' option.

methods.name: wrapStreaming
methods.description: Creates a combined handler that routes requests to either a default or a streaming handler based on the 'stream' option.
